mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO) growth, the supply chain is robust and corporate margins are stable, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market deterioration, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls from the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong housing demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST has increased for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth falls below 0.2% month-over-month, it signals a weakening supply chain, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
